pprof: provider profiling by components

Source: R/pprof-package.R
pprof-package.Rd

Components for profiling health care providers, organised by analysis step: data preparation (pp_data(), pp_check()), risk-adjustment models, standardized measures (standardize()), tests of provider effects (test()) and covariates (summary()), reference distributions, reliability, variable selection and plots. Every quality measure is assembled from these components; nothing in the package is specific to one measure.

Conventions

  • Every function takes a data frame and column names (y, x, provider, patient, n; time, start, event for survival outcomes).

  • Provider identifiers are handled as character strings and rows are sorted by provider, then patient, in the C locale; a patient's rows keep their input order, which the stabilized tests rely on.

  • Rates are proportions on the 0-1 scale.

  • Flags are 1 (above the reference), -1 (below), 0 (not different) or NA (not tested); which tail is "worse" is a property of the measure and is left to the caller.
